svg.title: THS RTOS task ownership and I/O data flow
svg.desc: STM32F411CE FreeRTOS data flow. Sensor HAL to loc_sensor, then BootstrapFrame one-slot mailbox to feature_nav and path_exec. feature_nav publishes FeatureSnapshot to path_exec; path_exec sends a one-slot stop-target back. SensorEvent FIFO holds 64 events after fusion starts; loc_fusion publishes PoseSnapshot to loc_logger and, only in explicit EKF mode, path_exec. path_exec publishes WheelCommand to motor_pwm; MotorSnapshot feeds back to path_exec. motor_pwm writes DRV8833 through the motor HAL. loc_key and ekf_spi issue control requests to navigation. bup_task and path_exec submit deferred logs to a bounded ring drained by ekf_spi. ekf_spi exchanges SPI data with an external ESP32-C6 bridge. Queue compartment drawings are symbolic; printed capacities are authoritative. Source: docs/fw_ths_architecture.md, RTOS task ownership and data flow, and linked task implementations.
svg.text: THS / RTOS task ownership & I/O data flow
STM32F411CE · FreeRTOS · FEATURE is the default navigation engine

g.text: P2 · 10 ms loop / 50 ms ToF polling

svg.text: Terminal stop helpers may write zero
One-slot state mailboxes retain the latest value for readers; stop targets are consumed. FIFO events preserve order; full-queue drops are counted.
Queue slots are symbolic; labels give capacity. Dots join flows; line crossings without dots do not. This is data flow, not a scheduler timeline.
Source: docs/fw_ths_architecture.md · “RTOS task ownership and data flow” and linked STM32 task implementations.
